Hi all —

Quick triage notes from the onboarding service: the click path is being rewritten by our email-proxy router. The proxy is adding a redirect step for tracking ("/_redirect?rd=portal&u=...") but it's URL-encoding the path and dropping the last path segment that contains the token payload. That explains the 404 + immediate invalidation.

I've attached a short debug dump from the router for the invite (invite_debug_log.txt). TL;DR: the invite token is still present in the original message body but gets truncated when the proxy transforms the href for click-tracking.

Workarounds while we fix the rewrite rule:
- Try right-click -> "Copy link address" and paste into browser address bar (some clients bypass the proxy when doing a direct paste).
- Use an incognito/private window (some mail clients inject extra tracking).
- If neither works, reply here and I can generate a one-time direct invite URL (no tracker) for immediate acceptance.

Planned fix: I'm going to change the proxy rewrite to preserve the trailing segment and pass the full path through as an encoded parameter instead of splitting on slashes. ETA for the fix: 24-48 hours.

Ben Carter
SRE, Onboarding Services
Redwood Inference
